jobs.title: Director, Data and Insights
jobs.description:
At Pacific Blue Cross, we're committed to improving health and wellbeing for British Columbians. As our Director, Data & Insights Office, you'll have a rare opportunity to build and shape a critical enterprise capability that will influence how decisions are made across the organization for years to come.

Reporting to the Vice President, Information Technology & Enterprise Transformation, you will lead the development of PBC's enterprise data, analytics, and AI strategy, helping transform data from an operational asset into a strategic advantage. Working closely with executive leaders and business partners, you will establish the foundations that enable trusted insights, stronger decision-making, and greater organizational agility.
This is more than a data leadership role. It is an opportunity to drive meaningful transformation across the organization. You'll influence enterprise priorities, champion innovation, and create a culture where data empowers teams to better serve members, improve operational performance, and deliver on PBC's long-term strategic objectives.

We're looking for a strategic and collaborative leader who is energized by building new capabilities, navigating complexity, and creating lasting organizational impact. You bring the vision to define what's possible, the influence to bring people together, and the execution focus to turn strategy into measurable results.

If your experience includes roles such as Director of Data & Analytics, Director of Business Intelligence, Head of Data & Insights, Director of Data Governance, Director of Enterprise Analytics, Director of Data Strategy, Director of AI & Analytics, Chief Data Officer, Analytics Director, Enterprise Data Leader, or similar leadership positions, and you've successfully leveraged data, analytics, and emerging technologies to drive business outcomes within industries such as healthcare, insurance, financial services, telecommunications, consulting, retail, or other complex, data-driven environments

Key Details

Position Title:
Director, Data and Insights
Work Arrangement:
Hybrid - 3 days in the office and 2 days’ work from home
Office Location:
4250 Canada Way, Burnaby, BC V5G 4W6
Classification:
Exempt
Salary Range:
$138,000 - $208,000 ( Pacific Blue Cross’ compensation program is built on a pay-for-performance philosophy, rewarding both individual and organizational achievements. We determine starting salaries by considering a variety of factors, including relevant skills, education, experience, and internal equity, ensuring compensation decisions are consistent, equitable, and reflective of each candidate’s unique background and qualifications)
Incentive Compensation Plan (ICP bonus) per year based on performance:
Up to 15.00%

Total Rewards Highlights:

Flexible working hours of 7.5 hours per day, Monday to Friday (i.e., 37.5 hours per week).
Paid vacation starts at 4 weeks per year and increases with years of service.
Generous benefits, including extended health, dental, and life insurance; depending on the plan that you choose, these benefit premiums can be 100% paid by PBC.
PBC contributes the equivalent of 8% of your base salary to a Defined Contribution pension plan. No employee contribution or matching is required, giving you more take-home pay

About Pacific Blue Cross

Pacific Blue Cross (PBC) has been British Columbia’s leading benefits provider for over 80 years. We are an independent, not-for-profit society with strong roots in BC’s health care system.

Why You'll Love Working Here

Retiree Benefits plan that is available to employees who have at least 10 years of service with PBC and have reached the age of 55.
Access to an onsite fitness center and cafeteria, along with employee events and activities designed to foster a collaborative and engaging work environment.
Access to virtual doctors/counsellors 24/7 via our Employee Family Assistance Program!
Learning and development opportunities
Wellness initiatives and onsite amenities

Keyways This Position Makes an Impact

Success in this role means transforming how Pacific Blue Cross leverages data, analytics, and artificial intelligence to drive better business outcomes. As the Director, Data & Insights Office, you will establish the strategy, governance, and capabilities needed to position data as a trusted enterprise asset while enabling more informed decision-making across the organization.

In this position, you will:
Build and lead PBC's enterprise Data & Insights Office, establishing governance frameworks, operating models, standards, and accountability to strengthen the organization's data maturity.
Drive enterprise data strategy and modernization initiatives, helping advance data quality, reporting consistency, analytics capabilities, and AI readiness across business and technology teams.
Enable data-driven decision-making by improving access to trusted information, empowering leaders with actionable insights, and expanding self-service analytics capabilities.
Champion analytics and AI innovation, identifying high-value opportunities that improve operational effectiveness, enhance member experiences, and deliver measurable business value.
Influence organizational transformation by fostering data literacy, building strategic partnerships, and creating alignment between business priorities, technology investments, and enterprise outcomes.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) with a major in Business, Data Science, Statistics, or an equivalent discipline, including or supplemented by courses in leadership/supervision.
Strong expertise in data governance, analytics, and emerging AI applications.
10 - 12 years of related experience in data and analytics including the application of insights into decision-making and/or automated processes.
7+ years of experience in progressively senior leadership positions.
Excellent project and change management skills.
Ability to translate business drivers and challenges into data insights and initiatives.

Key Competencies

Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify, analyze, and resolve challenges, driving solutions through to completion
Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship building skills with both business and technical stakeholders.

Ready to Apply?

If you're excited about this opportunity and eager to make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. When applying please ensure to upload your cover letter and resume. We thank all applicants for their interest. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Pacific Blue Cross, we are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We believe diversity, equity, and inclusion are essential to fostering innovation, collaboration, and a strong sense of belonging. Through ongoing learning, meaningful action, and community partnerships, we continue to build an inclusive culture where employees and members can thrive.

If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact careers@pac.bluecross.ca. We are committed to providing accessible and inclusive candidate experience.

jobs.title: Director - Deal Analytics
jobs.description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.

The Director of Deal Analytics leads the end-to-end data analytics process for mergers and acquisitions, providing strategic insights that support deal evaluation, financial reporting, and operational decision-making. This role collaborates with deal teams to analyze complex datasets, develop financial models, and identify growth opportunities through advanced analytics tools such as SQL and Tableau. Strong leadership, financial acumen, and technical expertise are essential to drive data-informed strategies and support client success.

Job Responsibilities

Leads and manages complex analytics and transaction engagements across buy-side and sell-side transactions.
Develops and delivers engagement approaches that meet client objectives and support high-quality outcomes.
Provides strategic insight to clients related to transaction evaluation, execution, and value creation.
Leads, mentors, and develops engagement teams while fostering a collaborative culture.
Supports business development efforts and enhances go-to-market strategies.
Builds and maintains strong client relationships across private equity and corporate clients.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
9+ years of experience.
Proven experience leading teams and managing complex engagements.

Preferred Qualifications

Big Four or similar consulting background.
Experience serving private equity clients.
Demonstrated success building and growing advisory practices.

Additional Role Expectations

Travel: As required by client engagements.
Peak Periods: Increased workload during active transactions.
Licensure Progress: Maintenance of relevant credentials.
Scheduling: Flexibility to meet client and business demands.

At RSM, we offer a competitive benefits and compensation package for all our people. We offer flexibility in your schedule, empowering you to balance life’s demands, while also maintaining your ability to serve clients. Learn more about our total rewards at https://rsmcanada.com/careers/life-at-rsm/rewards-and-benefits.html.

jobs.title: Senior Director Benefits Governance
jobs.description:
As Senior Director, Benefits Governance, you define the strategic direction and oversee the evolution of the Bank’s employee benefits offering. As a recognized leader in the field, you act as a trusted advisor to the leadership teams and contribute to attracting, engaging, and retaining talent through competitive, equitable, and business-aligned programs.

You lead a team of experts responsible for areas including group insurance, attendance and absence management, and occupational health and safety. You also ensure innovation, sound governance, regulatory compliance, and the effective management of investments related to the programs under your responsibility.

This strategic role gives you the opportunity to make a significant impact across the organization through your leadership, collaborative approach, and ability to mobilize stakeholders.

Your Role

Lead and develop a small team of specialized experts.

Act as a recognized leader and internal subject matter expert on employee benefits matters, supporting business priorities as well as talent attraction, engagement, and retention.

Define and evolve the strategies, policies, programs, and technology platforms that support the employee benefits offering.

Advise leadership teams on complex and strategic matters.

Monitor market trends to ensure a competitive and innovative benefits offering.

Collaborate with business partners to evolve programs based on the needs of the Bank and its employees.

Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, governance standards, and risk management practices.

Manage budgets, measure program performance, and drive value creation.

Develop and maintain strategic relationships with vendors and external partners.

Represent the Bank with external organizations and partners when required.

Your Team

Reporting to the Senior director, Wellness, Benefits & Recognition, within the Human Experience and Performance (HEP) sector, you will be part of the Total Rewards team, consisting of approximately 45 colleagues.

Our team is recognized for its deep expertise and innovative approach, focused on transforming and advancing total rewards practices.

We are committed to providing flexibility to support your quality of life through a hybrid work model and flexible work arrangements.

Prerequisites

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline and 7 to 10 years of experience, or a master’s degree and a minimum of 5 years of experience.

Recognized expertise in the design and evolution of employee benefits, health and wellness, retirement programs, or related fields.

Demonstrated leadership experience in managing and developing specialized teams.

Ability to define strategic directions and lead complex initiatives in a transforming environment.

Excellent influencing, communication, and advisory skills with senior leadership and a broad range of stakeholders.

Strong analytical, decision-making, and financial management capabilities, including the use of data to inform recommendations.

Proven ability to innovate, mobilize teams, and build lasting partnerships internally and externally.

Languages: French, English
Reason to require this language: you will need to carry out regularly tasks that require the use of IT apps and tools unavailable in French.
Required skills: Business Alignment, Critical Thinking, Data-Driven Decision-Making, Decision Making, Diversity & Inclusion, Emotional Intelligence, Innovation Management, Learning Agility, Managerial Courage, Mobilization, Partner Development, Resiliency, Risk Management, Strategic Vision, Strategy Execution, Stress Management

Your benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, upon hiring you’ll be eligible for a wide range of flexible benefits to help promote your wellbeing and that of your family such as:

* Health and wellness program, including many options
* Flexible group insurance
* Generous pension plan
* Employee Share Ownership Plan
* Employee and family assistance program
* Preferential banking services
* Involvement in community initiatives
* Telemedicine service
* Virtual sleep clinic

We have an offer that keeps up with trends as well as your needs and those of your family.

Our dynamic work environments and cutting-edge collaboration tools foster a positive employee experience. We value employees’ ideas. Whether through our surveys or programs, regular feedback and ongoing communication are encouraged.

Making a bold move in a people-first environment

We’re a bank on a human scale that stands out for its courage, entrepreneurial culture, and passion for people. Our mission is to have a positive impact on people’s lives. Our core values of partnership, agility, and empowerment inspire us, and inclusion is central to our commitments. We aim, wherever possible, to provide a barrier-free and accessible environment to all employees.

We strive to provide accessibility measures throughout the recruitment process within the limits of our available resources. If you require accommodations, feel free to let us know during our initial conversations. We welcome all candidates! What can you bring to our team?

Join us!

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

J Dass

Full-time

In-Office | Vaughan, ON, Canada

The Opportunity

You’re the kind of person who is always looking to learn. You want to grow into something greater and you’re looking for an employer encourages and supports your professional development. J Dass promotes advancement and rewards our employees based on individual performance and merit. Sure you’ll have exposure to the team, but all of our people are accountable for their success. Competitive and focused, our team is on a mission to deliver excellence. We also know that this can only be accomplished by supporting our employee growth and development. By providing frequent feedback and consistently measuring progress, we’ve discovered the recipe for success that’s delivered year over year growth since our first year of business. This a culture of winning. At J Dass we breed winners.

Responsibilities

Oversee financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting to guide growth strategy.
Drive cash flow management and working capital optimization.
Develop and monitor KPIs and dashboards for revenue, costs, and pipelines.
Provide strategic financial guidance to executive team for decision making.
Lead fundraising efforts and investor relations to support expansion.
Ensure compliance with accounting standards and internal controls.
Identify cost optimization opportunities without compromising growth.
Build scalable financial processes and systems to support rapid growth.
Manage treasury functions and risk management to safeguard assets.
Lead annual audit and liaise with external auditors.
Develop talent within the finance team and promote merit-based advancement.

Experience/Qualifications

CPA/CA or equivalent, with strong IFRS/GAAP knowledge.
10+ years finance leadership, preferably in growth-stage companies.
Proven experience in fundraising and investor relations.
Fluent in building scalable FP&A processes and dashboards.
Strong cash flow, working capital, and treasury management skills.
Track record of implementing internal controls and audit readiness.
Strategic advisory mindset with ahigh emphasis on KPIs and data-driven decisions.
Talent development: experience building and mentoring finance teams.
Experience in risk management and regulatory compliance across jurisdictions.
On-site availability with ability to collaborate closely with executive team.

What's in it for you? (Salary, Commissions & Benefits)

On-site role based in Vaughan, ON — enjoy a collaborative, in-person work environment
Competitive base salary as the core of your compensation package
